moa: Dual phosphodiesterase 3 and 4 (PDE3/PDE4) inhibitor with bronchodilator and non-steroidal anti-inflammatory activity

approval_evidence.quote: This NDA provides for the use of Ohtuvayre (ensifentrine) inhalation suspension, a phosphodiesterase 3 (PDE3) inhibitor and phosphodiesterase 4 (PDE4) inhibitor, for the maintenance treatment of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) in adult patients. (FDA approval letter, NDA 217389, signed 06/26/2024)

revenue_scope: U.S. net product sales of Ohtuvayre: Verona Pharma's product sales line (U.S.-only commercialisation, sole product) and the U.S. column of Merck's product sales table in its 10-Q.
geography: U.S. Verona's 10-Qs state Ohtuvayre is commercialised in the U.S. only; Merck's 10-Q sales-by-product table has U.S., Int'l and Total columns and prints Int'l as nil for Ohtuvayre in 2026Q1 and 2026Q2 (so U.S. equals Total).
series_start_reason: First quarter with product sales; Verona's Q3 2024 release states the August 2024 launch (FDA approval June 26, 2024); 2024Q2 has no sales.
series_end_reason: Latest published quarter at the time of sourcing (Merck 10-Q for the quarter ended 2026-06-30, filed 2026-08-07).

unreported_quarters.2025Q3: Verona was acquired on October 7, 2025 and filed no Q3 2025 10-Q or release (EDGAR submissions list ends with the Oct 2025 8-K, S-8 POS and 15-12G filings). Merck's Q3 2025 earnings release (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/310158/000110465925103974/tm2529620d1_ex99-1.htm) mentions the acquisition only as an October event and has no Ohtuvayre sales line.
unreported_quarters.2025Q4: Merck's Q4 2025 release prints OHTUVAYRE 178 but labels it 'Represents sales following the Company's Oct. 7, 2025 acquisition of Verona Pharma plc', a partial quarter, so it is not spliced into a full-quarter series.

notes: Scope is consistent across the join: both issuers' rows are U.S. net sales. Merck's earnings-release table is worldwide, but its 10-Qs split U.S. and Int'l and print Int'l as nil for Ohtuvayre in 2026Q1 and 2026Q2, so the 10-Q U.S. column is used (equal to the release figures 131 and 204). Merck's 2025 10-K prints Ohtuvayre 178 in the U.S. column for the post-acquisition period. Verona 2024 quarterly values 5.624 + 36.637 = 42.261, equal to the 2024 year printed in the Q4 2024 release (42,261). Verona's Q3 2024 release prints no separate 'Product sales' row; its only revenue line is 'Revenue' 5,624 and the text calls it Ohtuvayre net sales. Q1/Q2 2025 total revenue also includes Other revenue (5,000 and 199 respectively), excluded here. Merck's Q4 2025 release prints OHTUVAYRE 178 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/310158/000110465926009495/tm264564d1_ex99-1.htm) labelled as sales following the October 7, 2025 acquisition, a partial quarter, deliberately not included (same treatment as abbvie_elahere).

Read each release's tables and text with BeautifulSoup row extraction; figures in the quotes are copied from those rows

FDA approval letter NDA 217389 fetched from accessdata.fda.gov and read (approval 06/26/2024)

[Merck piece] EDGAR submissions for Merck (CIK 310158): earnings 8-Ks of 2025-10-30, 2026-02-03, 2026-04-30, 2026-08-04 downloaded; OHTUVAYRE row read in Q4 2025, Q1 2026 and Q2 2026 releases; Q3 2025 release has no Ohtuvayre sales line
[Merck piece] Bigdata.com search 'Merck Ohtuvayre sales fourth quarter 2025' pointed to the Q4 2025 call and slides ($178M)

launch_evidence.quote: In August 2024, the Company launched Ohtuvayre for the maintenance treatment of COPD in the US.
